admission.justification: Successful object lookups inside one request-local Git memo. Losing this boundary would fabricate currentness, attribute another owner's work, hide an external change, or repeat an unsafe host/landing action rather than exposing the actual observation.

applicability: Successful object lookups inside one request-local Git memo.
conditions: Repository, work directory, complete execution environment, output mode and literal argv form the key.
Exact object IDs and the supported replace-proof forms alone qualify.
exclusions: Failures, refs, mutable worktrees, replacement-sensitive forms and suffixed malformed IDs execute fresh.
statement: Memo eligibility uses fullmatch for exact40/64-character object and supported peel forms; newline, CRLF, space and extra-line suffixes execute natively without entering the memo, whose native success/environment/replacement controls remain.
